Kith'rak Voss is a determined Githyanki knight in the service of his queen,  Vlaakith. He rides a red dragon named  Qudenos.

Background

Voss is a legendary Kith'rak in githyanki society who reports directly to the lich queen Vlaakith CLVII. Per  Lae'zel and lore found in-game, Voss has been the right-hand knight of Vlaakith and her predecessors, dating back to Vlaakith I, who succeeded the first githyanki leader Gith thousands of years in the past. Qudenos the Red Dragon is his mount and closest comrade.[1]

Voss is direct and ruthless, expecting the deference due both his rank and possession of Vlaakith's personal silver sword. Other gith characters, including Lae'zel, hold him in esteem and may even be cowed by his presence. He still talks with – and may even be friendly to – non-gith, but githyanki party members or those who appear as a githyanki by use of  Disguise Self have special interactions with Voss that reflect their place in gith society.

Involvement

Act One

For the transcript of Voss's Act 1 appearance, see Voss/Transcript.

Mountain Pass

During Act One, the party can first encounter Voss if they venture close enough to the Mountain Pass area to the northwest of Waukeen's Rest. A group of githyanki has just slain a Flaming Fist patrol, and Voss lands astride Qudenos to chide them and issue orders. Interacting with them advances ⁠Find the Githyanki Crèche.

If Kith'rak Voss or the other githyanki are approached by the party, he interrogates the interacting party member about the object of his mission, the  Mysterious Artefact which he has been charged to retrieve for use against the Mind Flayers.[2]

The interrogation is a gauntlet of ability checks. The interacting party member must first convince Voss not to kill them on the spot followed by an  DC 10 Arcana Check check to perceive his hidden casting of  Detect Thoughts, and then a  DC 10 Wisdom Check check to resist it. Warlocks recognize the spell, bypass the Arcana check, and then only need a  DC 5 Wisdom Check check to resist it. The interrogation can then end peacefully with a third successful check.

Regardless of how the interrogation ends, Voss departs on Qudenos once the dialogue is concluded. He does not participate in combat and, if preemptively engaged, flies away with Qudenos at the first opportunity (usually immediately).

Lae'zel

If Lae'zel is present, she immediately runs to Voss without the party.[3]. If the player character follows her, the event proceeds as above. If the party leave, Lae'zel dies, Voss flies away, and the other githyanki under his command become hostile.

Campsite Visit

Once ⁠Discover the Artefact's Secrets is complete, Kith'rak Voss makes a surprise visit upon the Party's first Fast Travel or Long Rest outside of the Crêche. He speaks directly to Lae'zel, attempting to reason with her about the truth of Vlaakith's tyranny after her own recent betrayal. Further, he claims to be opposing Vlaakith's reign, and that the occupant within the Artefact is the key to her being overthrown. A critical choice must be made:

  • If the party choose to listen to him and reason with Lae'zel, he urges them to meet him again in Baldur's Gate at Sharess' Caress.
  • Alternatively, it is possible to urge Lae'zel to attack him, leading to an optional boss fight. This has considerable consequences, yet earns the party  Voss' Silver Sword[4]. The  Letter to Voss on his body directs the party to Sharess' Caress, continuing ⁠The Githyanki Warrior questline.
  • If Lae'zel is has never been recruited, then she will be dead and Voss will therefor not visit to the Party's camp when leaving the Crêche region after completing ⁠Discover the Artefact's Secrets. This impacts certain buffs (e.g.  Morninglord's Radiance from solving the four weapons puzzle as part of the ⁠Find the Blood of Lathander quest) by not clearing them since the forced Long Rest from Voss' visit—which would usually clear them—doesn't happen.

Act Three

Sharess' Caress

Voss moves to Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing, which starts the ⁠Help Kith'rak Voss quest, where he tries to make a deal with  Raphael in the Devil's Den, but Voss has nothing to offer him. Raphael is in possession of the  Orphic Hammer, a tool that can break the cage that holds  Orpheus the githyanki prince and son of Gith.

Orpheus has long since come to realize that Vlaakith I betrayed his mother. He led Gith's Honour Guard in a revolt and named himself the rightful king of the githyanki, triggering the War of the Comet. At the head of the Honour Guard mounted on red dragons, Orpheus fought Vlaakith's knights in a battle in the Astral Plane, where he praised Gith and accused Vlaakith. Yet he was overcome and defeated by Kith'rak Voss on Qudenos and imprisoned within the  Astral Prism so that Vlaakith I (and her successors, now Vlaakith CLVII) could exploit the powers he inherited from his mother.

Years later, Voss came to realise Vlaakith does not act in the interests of githyanki, and swore to free Gith's rightful successor.

Lower City Sewers

If the party sign the deal with Raphael, they can immediately show it to Voss, who then gifts the party a  Silver Sword of the Astral Plane, a precious cultural item of the githyanki. Voss then departs to prepare his forces to take on the Elder Brain.

If the party refuse Raphael's deal, Voss moves to the Lower City Sewers north and slight east of the City Sewers waypoint. There, he waits for the party to show him the  Orphic Hammer and after this, he grants them the silver sword before leaving to gather his forces.

If the party attack him in the sewers, he calls them traitors and teleports away on his turn, even if restrained, silenced, or merely incapacitated; he can still be killed if defeated in a single turn.

Upper City

Voss confronts the party as they approach High Hall. His reaction varies greatly depending on the choices that the party made inside the Astral Prism after their initial loss to the Netherbrain:

If the party free Orpheus and either Karlach or the player character becomes a mind flayer, Voss is overjoyed at his prince's freedom. He then agrees to help the party as part of the ⁠Gather Your Allies quest.

If the party free Orpheus and allowing him to sacrifice himself to become a mind flayer, then Voss initially believes they betrayed him and killed Orpheus. He is shocked and horrified to learn his prince sacrificed himself for the cause, yet still offers to help the party as part of the ⁠Gather Your Allies quest.

If the party trust the Emperor and let him or Karlach consume Orpheus, Voss becomes enraged and the party must pass a  DC 30 Persuasion Check or  DC 30 Deception Check to prevent him from attacking them. If successful, Voss stands down and agrees to help the party as part of the ⁠Gather Your Allies quest.

If the party trust the Emperor and the player character becomes a mind flayer and consumes Orpheus, then an additional  DC 25 Persuasion Check or  DC 25 Intimidation Check must be passed before the  DC 30 Persuasion Check or  DC 30 Deception Check to prevent Voss from attacking and secure his aid in the ⁠Gather Your Allies quest.

Encounter - The Upper City

  • If the party completed the ⁠Help Kith'rak Voss quest or disarmed him during Act One, then he wields  Voss' Silver Sword instead of  Silver Sword of the Astral Plane.
  • Voss is accompanied by Veteran Gish, Veteran Raider, and Veteran Warrior.

Idle banter

Voss has an idle conversation with Qudenos inside the Lower City Sewers in Act Three.

  • Qudenos
    Even with Prince Orpheus to guide us, we are too small in number to defeat Vlaakith alone.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    We will not be alone, Qudenos.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    For a thousand years, we have been planting the seeds of revolution.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    In every crèche, many young whisper Orpheus' name. They do Vlaakith's duty, but out of fear, not faith.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    When the Prince of the Comet blazes his path, they will follow. And so will countless others.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    The time is soon upon us, Qudenos. I will not forget your loyalty, friend.
  • Qudenos
    The lich queen has shackled the red dragons as surely as she has shackled the githyanki.
  • Qudenos
    You will be the first to battle. And I will be the one to carry you.
  • Qudenos
    This Lae'zel and her allies. Can they be trusted?
  • Kith'rak Voss
    You ask the wrong question. It is not a matter of 'can'. It is a matter of 'must'.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    Whether by fortune or necessity, fate made its choice.
  • Kith'rak Voss
    Lae'zel was the opportunity we prayed for. This may be our one chance to secure githyanki freedom.

Notes and references

  2. ↑ Depending on the party's choices and Lae'zel's decisions as a result, it may later be revealed that Voss has his own plans for the  Artefact.
  3. ↑ If Lae'zel is freed from the Tieflings' cage but not invited to travel with the party, she can be observed running up to Kith'rak Voss just after the introductory scene triggers.
  4. ↑ It is also possible to acquire the  Silver Sword of the Astral Plane, a weapon far superior to  Voss' Silver Sword, substantially earlier than his first camp visit, by use of this guide.
  5. ↑ Voss can be traded with in dialogue as early as Act One. Prior to Patch 6 he would also sell this item during Act 3.
